inputSchema.description: One page-owned asynchronous effect lease evaluated before a client-side state commit.

accessToken.description: Exact token owner; never logged by the runtime.

requestGeneration.description: Monotonic request generation within the lane.

outputSchema.description: Deterministic decision whether the effect may update the current page instance.

accepted.description: True only for the current visible exact owner and latest lane request.

contracts.authorization: Local-only guard: currentAuthSession must exactly match userId, accessToken and generation before any page state commit.
contracts.idempotency: Latest-wins per page instance and lane; invalidation is monotonic within a visibility generation.
contracts.compatibility: v1 changes no API or storage contract; adding or weakening owner fields requires a new contract version and release unit.

observability.correlation: The lane and monotonic request generation correlate local effects without exposing the access token.
observability.audit: No persistent audit record or token logging is added; executable tests prove accepted and rejected transitions.
observability.metrics: No production metric is added in this scoped unit; tests count accepted versus stale effects deterministically.

inputSchema.description: One authenticated Companion memory list, create, update, delete, clear or enablement request.

memoryId.description: Stable memory item identifier when one item is addressed.

revision.description: Current optimistic concurrency revision for an exact update.

outputSchema.description: The user-owned memory item, current memory snapshot or deterministic mutation result.

success.description: Whether the represented operation completed deterministically.

changedCount.description: Rows changed by a clear or delete operation.

memoryId.description: Stable identifier of the returned item.

revision.description: Current item revision after the operation.

items.description: Current long-term memory items for the authenticated user.
One explicit user-owned long-term memory item.

source.description: Evidence that the user explicitly created the item.

shortTermTurnCount.description: Number of live short-term turns across supported Companion channels.

shortTermExpiresAt.description: Latest ISO-8601 expiry among the live short-term turns.

contracts.authorization: Bearer-authenticated user; every select, update and delete is constrained by the exact current user_id.
contracts.idempotency: Create requires an Idempotency-Key and deterministically replays only the same normalized payload; updates require the current revision and exact-state PUT semantics; clear and setting writes are naturally idempotent.
contracts.compatibility: Additive fields may be added within v1; categories, delete semantics, ownership and revision conflicts require a new version.

observability.correlation: HTTP request IDs correlate mutations; Idempotency-Key is fingerprinted rather than returned or logged as content.
observability.audit: Mutation outcomes and stale revision conflicts are observable through request correlation; memory content is not written to application logs.
observability.metrics: Count create, update, delete, clear and conflict outcomes without memory content labels.
